caption: The drawing features a wooden cabinet composed of two main sections, an upper and a lower compartment. The cabinet is rendered primarily in shades of brown, suggesting different types of wood or wood finishes. The upper part contains three rectangular drawers along the top, each decorated with carved floral or geometric designs. Beneath the drawers, there are two smaller side doors with diamond-shaped carvings and a central panel that has a vertical ornamental motif. The upper section is supported by two dark, turned baluster columns which rest atop the lower part of the cabinet. The lower section features two large doors, each divided into three vertically oriented, arched panels filled with carved foliage and scrollwork designs. The sides and lower plinth are also decorated with panelling and subtle carved patterns. The visible surfaces of the cabinet show a mix of light and dark wood tones, highlighting the details of the carving and the form of the structure. The cabinet sits on four short legs, with the front two being more prominent and rounded. The background is plain, and the cabinet is viewed at a slight angle, allowing both the front and one side to be seen.
title: Press Cupboard
